pageApproval.substantialPassDefinition: No material defect remains that would justify regenerating or repairing this page before advancing production.
pageApproval.userOverride: Any explicit user rejection, redo, correction, replacement, or supersession overrides automatic approval.

visualIdentityApproval.newIdentity: A substantially passing production image may establish the first durable visual identity for a newly introduced recurring character, ship, location, or prop when no prior released or approved visual authority exists.
visualIdentityApproval.existingIdentity: A production image that conforms to an existing identity does not replace that identity; it is approved only as the current production draft for its recipe.
visualIdentityApproval.redesign: Replacing an existing released or approved visual identity requires explicit user intent to lock or adopt the redesign.

persistence.frontierRule: Production frontier is derived from released canon plus approved production drafts; it is never stored as a chat cursor.
